# Lytz — GitHub Copilot

Before doing anything in this project, read `AGENTS.md` at the repository root in full and follow it. It holds the locked rules every assistant must follow, plus the list of docs to read before any change (`docs/status.md`, `docs/architecture.md`, `docs/design-system.md`, `docs/testing.md`, `docs/decisions.md`).

If a request would break a locked rule, stop, name the rule, and ask the owner.
